scope: Proposition 5.8 (Extensive simultaneous crowding) of the manuscript “The Boltzmann–Grad limit for stable radial potentials on regular kinetic intervals” (preprints/The-Boltzmann-Grad-limit-for-stable-radial-potentials-on-regular-kinetic-intervals-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce9fe5976f17b89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix A, Q, L, R and δ > 0. Among indepen- dently enveloped finite histories with p ≤ PA and S ≤ Rp, the activity-normalized integral for which at some time at least δp displayed labels have a companion within ρ = ε.85 is bounded by ηΓPCA,Q,L,Rp ε.275δp−1 . (5.22) For δp ≥ 8 this is at most ηΓε.1δp for sufficiently small ε, uniformly in the stated range of p.
